choice_prompt:2:1711157001.text: Just as Kraft had confessed, the report was hidden in a secret compartment under the floorboards of the guard's cabin! It took me three whole planks to dig it out!
choice_prompt:2:1711157001.source_cn: 就像克拉夫特交代的那样，报告就藏在看守小屋地板下的暗格里！我足足拆了三块木板才把它挖出来！

say:3:1711157002:1.text: Hehe. This is the stolen "Bantis Border Survey Report".
say:3:1711157002:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿。这就是那份失窃的《班题斯边境调研报告》。

say:6:1711157004:0.text: You recall the location of Aya's disappearance and the report that Dilgrey insisted on destroying...
say:6:1711157004:0.source_cn: 你回忆起之前艾雅的失踪地，与迪尔格雷执意要销毁的报告……

say:10:1711157006:1.text: I can't believe... that such primitive and dangerous witchcraft still exists in the world?
say:10:1711157006:1.source_cn: 真不敢相信……世间竟然还有如此原始又危险的巫术？

say:12:1711157008:1.text: Kirsty, the academic books you've studied are too orthodox.
say:12:1711157008:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，你学的那些学院派理论书籍还是太正统了。

say:13:1711157009:1.text: It's common for some audacious forces along the border to specialize in this kind of business.
say:13:1711157009:1.source_cn: 边境上有些胆大包天的势力，专门做这种生意，也是常事。

say:14:1711157010:1.text: Even if it's to go to the territory of the undead?

say:15:1711157011:1.text: People die for money. However, there's one thing I don't quite understand.
say:15:1711157011:1.source_cn: 人为财死。不过，我有一点不太理解。

choice_prompt:18:1711157013.text: Is it because it mentions "certain chambers of commerce"? What is Deergray covering up for the Black Gold Chamber of Commerce?
choice_prompt:18:1711157013.source_cn: 是因为里面提到了“某些商会”？迪尔格雷在为黑金商会掩盖些什么？

say:19:1711157014:1.text: You're going to Bandis?! Lord Merlin! That's too dangerous!
say:19:1711157014:1.source_cn: 您要去班题斯？！梅林大人！这太危险了！

say:20:1711157015:0.text: Lord Merlin, the situation in the capital has not yet been completely resolved. Why do you suddenly want to go to a place like that?
say:20:1711157015:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，王都的事情还没彻底平息，您为什么突然要去那种地方？

choice_prompt:21:1711157015.text: Lord Merlin, the situation in the capital has not yet been completely resolved. Why do you suddenly want to go to a place like that?
choice_prompt:21:1711157015.source_cn: 梅林大人，王都的事情还没彻底平息，您为什么突然要去那种地方？

choice_prompt:24:1711157019.text: You didn't tell them any clues about Aya's disappearance in Bandis. This matter involves many factions, and the less they know, the safer it will be for these two young mages.
choice_prompt:24:1711157019.source_cn: 你并没有告诉他们艾雅在班题斯失踪的线索。这件事牵扯到了诸多势力，知道得越少，对这两个年轻的魔法师来说就越安全。

say:25:1711157020:0.text: In that case, please be extremely careful!
say:25:1711157020:0.source_cn: 既然如此，请您务必万分小心！

say:26:1711157021:1.source_cn: 祝您一切顺利，梅林大人。

choice:24:0:1.text: Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.

choice:24:1:2.text: This report was a great help.

choice:24:2:3.text: I'll set off once I've dealt with the remaining few tricky matters.
choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 等我把剩下的几件棘手事处理完，就会动身

choice:21:0:1.text: There are reasons why you absolutely must go.

say:29:1711157018:0.text: ...Why does this sound like a joke to me?
say:29:1711157018:0.source_cn: ……怎么我听着完全不像玩笑呢？

choice:21:1:2.text: Because I haven't been there yet.

choice:18:0:1.text: Once I go to Bandis myself, I'll understand.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 等我亲自去一趟班题斯，自然就清楚了
